newsitem.title: USA: First Fin Caribbean sees no storm effect.
newsitem.headline: First Fin Caribbean sees no storm effect.

text.p: First Financial Caribbean Corp said on Wednesday that its operations are normal at its servicing facilities after the passage of Hurricane Hortense and that the storm would not have a material adverse effect on its operations for the rest of 1996.
Electrical power has been restored to many branch offices and that the company's origination facilities are expected to be fully operations by September 16, 1996, the company said.
All residences securing mortgage loans originated or serviced by the company are fully insured against property damage, First Financial said.
